propositions: Automated bug filers spam duplicates and file on single flakes due to missing dedup keys and consecutive-red thresholds.
Three existing filers (heartbeat-alert, binding-drift-alert, and conflict-filer) lack stable dedup tags, templated bodies, empty-detail abort logic, and detected_by attribution.

Heartbeat-filer must implement 2-consecutive-red threshold by querying workflow run history with no new state store; binding-drift-filer skips threshold (drift is persistent state) but gains dedup and accumulation; conflict-filer gains per-pair sha1 dedup tag.
Bug-creation contract (rebar create args, exit codes, dedup search, REBAR_DETECTED_BY env) must be documented to standardize future filers.
Accumulation dedup via marker-line in ticket comment history (max one per 24h) and green-with-no-ticket paths must no-op with exit 0, preserving existing auto-close divergence for alert filers.
